deficiencies.description: The rewrite treats 'meningioma' as an anatomical site or organ where a tumour occurs ('when the tumour occurs in a meningioma or in the liver'). In medical fact and in the lecture, a meningioma is itself a type of primary tumour (originating in the meninges), not an anatomical location inside which tumours develop.
